text: Election of the Vice-Chair of the Toronto Preservation Board in accordance with Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures By-law, Appendix A-II, effective March 22, 2018 for a term consistent with Council and until a successor is appointed.
The Toronto Preservation Board: 1. Elected Sandra Shaul as Vice Chair of the Toronto Preservation Board for a term of office starting March 22, 2018 and ending on November 30, 2018.
